changes: The network state (the record of what Terraform built for the network) changes its port from 8080 to 9090. The app state gains a database migration that fails.
watch: Wave 1 (the first group of states to apply) changes network. App's migration then fails in wave 2 (the states that read from wave 1), and network stays changed. The driver (the script running this demo) clears the fault and runs the pipeline again. The re-run has to replace the failed migration. That destroys something, so it asks a person first. With that approval the change finishes.
shows: A failure doesn't undo what already landed. The pipeline shows where it stopped, and a second run completes the change.
